title: Mirum: eRx to a specialty pharmacy, with APA and the patient scheduling

demos.label: 1. ABV with APA, specialty pharmacy ships
demos.description: The prescriber sends the eRx to Mirum Pharmacy. The patient onboards by text while the benefit check runs and finds a PA is required. APA emails the prescriber a form. After the approval the patient schedules the delivery, the agent dispatches in the CRM, and the pharmacy ships.

brand.name: Mirum
documents: Mirum-AccessPlus.html (saved copy of the Mirum Access Plus site)

winTheme: One eRx starts everything: onboarding, the benefit check, an APA form the prescriber completes online, and a delivery scheduled by the patient and dispatched to Mirum's own pharmacy.
openQuestions: Who owns patient communications for Mirum? Their agents do, so is the Patient UI branded Mirum or us?
Is Mirum Pharmacy a real pharmacy or a stand-in name? The brand file holds a placeholder address and phone number.
The drug is commercially covered with no copay or price shown. Does the patient ever see a cost?
Does the PA decision land when the agent opens the PA stage, as it does in the other demos, or automatically after the prescriber submits?
